messages.subject: Got your Meta invitation — here's where to watch the activity
messages.body:
Hi Nassim,

Thanks for setting the accounts up and inviting us into the
prestigewindowsaz business portfolio — the invitation came through this
afternoon and we're accepting it on our end. That was the piece we were
waiting on, so we can now start building the pages out and posting.

You asked how to see what's happening on the accounts yourself.
Everything for both Facebook and Instagram lives in one place — Meta
Business Suite — and you can check it any time without going through us.

1. Open Meta Business Suite
   Go to business.facebook.com and sign in with the same login you used
   to create the accounts.

2. Switch to the Prestige Windows account
   This is the part that trips people up. If you manage more than one
   business, it opens on whichever one it saw last — likely Prestige
   Home Studio. Click the account name in the top-left corner and pick
   prestigewindowsaz from the list. Everything on screen then refers to
   that account only.

3. Home — what just happened
   New followers, comments, messages and reactions as they come in.

4. Insights — how it's performing
   Reach, visits, follower growth and which posts did anything, with
   Facebook and Instagram side by side. You can change the date range
   at the top.

5. Content — what's published and what's queued
   Every post that's gone out, plus anything scheduled ahead.

On your phone it's the same thing in the Meta Business Suite app (iOS
and Android) — the account switcher sits at the top of the screen
